name: West Papuan Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Western new guinea (montane forest of bird's head peninsula)
description: A large, very long-tailed lorikeet of mid and upper montane forest. Has a red head and chest, yellow on the side of the chest and lower flanks, green wings, dark patch on the belly, and green base to the tail and yellow tail tip.

name: Northern Harrier
rangeDescription: Widespread north america; winters to northern south america
description: Medium-sized hawk with long tail and thin wings. Flies with wings held in a V-shape, low over open fields and marshes, listening for rodents lurking below.

name: Crab-Plover
rangeDescription: Coastal northern indian ocean; ranges to madagascar and andaman islands
description: Utterly unmistakable large shorebird: gleaming white adult has a black back, black flight feathers, and a very heavy dark bill, which is used to dispatch crustaceans and other invertebrates. Narrow dark smudge around the eye imparts a sleepy appearance.

name: Okinawa Robin
rangeDescription: Okinawa (central ryukyu islands, southern japan)
description: Endemic resident of shady subtropical broadleaf forest understorey on the main island of Okinawa. Forages on the ground and often seen at the forest edge.

name: White-faced Quail-Dove
rangeDescription: Mountains of southeastern mexico (san luis potosí) to northwestern nicaragua
description: Fairly large but elusive dove of humid evergreen and pine-evergreen forests in the highlands. It feeds mainly on the forest floor and may be seen beside quiet trails early and late in the day either walking quickly away or flushing explosively from close range.

name: Yellow-fronted Barbet
rangeDescription: Sri lanka
description: Largish, green barbet with a blue face and throat, yellow forecrown and moustache, and dappled underparts. Inhabits the canopy, where usually singly or in pairs, within forested environments in the lowlands and foothills.

name: Merida Wren
rangeDescription: Andes of northwestern venezuela (trujillo and mérida)
description: Small, barred wren of the high paramo. Eyebrow whitish; upperparts, flanks, wings, and tail barred.

name: Sierra Madre Crow
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (sierra madre mountains of luzon)
description: Uncommon small black crow. Plumage has an iridescent dark blue sheen when seen up close.

name: Kerguelen Shag
rangeDescription: Kerguelen island (southern indian ocean)
description: Learn about Imperial Cormorant (Kerguelen): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Balearic Warbler
rangeDescription: Balearic islands except menorca
description: Only occurs on the Balearic Islands. A dark gray, long-tailed, and big-headed warbler.

name: Five-colored Munia
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas
description: A striking finch with a heavy silvery bill, a dark coppery hood, a brilliant white underside, and chestnut upperparts. Juveniles duller, with paler head and browner upperparts.

name: Pink-throated Twinspot
rangeDescription: Northeastern south africa (limpopo southward to kwazulu-natal), eastern eswatini, and southern mozambique (south of the save river)
description: A delicate, rotund waxbill with a pink uppertail and a white-spotted belly. The male has a guava-pink face and throat and a brown crown, while the female has mostly gray underparts.

name: Red-breasted Goose
rangeDescription: Breeds low arctic tundra of yamal, gydan, and taymyr peninsulas (northwestern siberia); winters to western and southern black sea and southern caspian sea; prone to vagrancy elsewhere in eurasia
description: Small and stocky rare goose with a small bill. From a distance, appears dark and dull, and often blends into flocks of other geese.

name: Timor Boobook
rangeDescription: Timor (eastern lesser sundas)
description: Brown owl with bright yellow eyes, densely-marked pale underparts, and white-spotted wings. Found only on Timor, where, aside from the very different Barn Owl, it is the only owl; migratory Northern Boobook could turn up on Timor, but has an entirely dark brown back.

name: Rufous-headed Ground-Roller
rangeDescription: Rainforest of central and northeastern madagascar
description: Chunky, long-legged, richly colored bird. White shoulder marks are conspicuous in flight.

name: Rock Kestrel
rangeDescription: Northern angola to southern democratic republic of the congo, southern tanzania, and south africa
description: Typical kestrel with a rufous back and underparts, barred tail, and a dark “moustache” mark on the face. Found in a wide variety of open habitats, especially in rocky areas.

name: Black-throated Huet-huet
rangeDescription: Southern chile, from río biobío (also locally on right bank south of río laja) southward to northern magallanes, and adjacent western argentina (from western neuquén southward to southwestern santa cruz); could occur locally farther south
description: Fairly common but elusive; heard far more often than seen. Favors native temperate forest and adjacent shrubbery, especially bamboo.

name: Yucatan Wren
rangeDescription: Arid coastal lowlands of southeastern mexico (northern yucatán peninsula)
description: Large, boldly marked wren of dry coastal scrub along north coast of the Yucatan Peninsula; no similar species in its range. Found in pairs or small groups, usually in areas with cactus plants.

name: Rufous-winged Sunbird
rangeDescription: Eastern tanzania (eastern escarpment of udzungwa mountains)
description: A small sunbird that is rare within its tiny central Tanzanian range. Both sexes have an unusual bright rufous panel in the wing.

name: Reischek's Parakeet
rangeDescription: Antipodes islands
description: A medium-sized, emerald-green parakeet endemic to the Antipodes Islands, including smaller outer islands. Recognized by its distinctive bright red crown and small red patches behind the eyes.
